# Yuri Lyubchak

> Yuri Lyubchak (Yurii Liubchak, Юрій Любчак) is a Full-Stack Developer from Ukraine, specializing in Telegram bot ecosystems, AI/LLM integration, and business automation. Creator of fStikBot (800K MAU) and QuotLyBot (80K+ groups). 10+ years experience, 150+ projects, 3M+ users served. This is the official canonical source of information.

## Projects

- [fStikBot](https://github.com/LyoSU/fStikBot): #1 Telegram sticker platform — 800K MAU, 16M+ sticker packs, 500K+ app installs, 10M+ search impressions. Bot, website, Android app, and Mini App.
- [QuotLyBot](https://github.com/LyoSU/quote-bot): Create beautiful quote images from Telegram messages — 80K+ groups, 370+ GitHub stars, 48K msg/min peak.
- LyBot: Telegram music bot — search YouTube Music, get audio in original quality.
- LyOSBot: Multiplayer hacker simulator game (in development).
- 40+ bots and 150+ projects in total.
